comment: Agent SoW: the signed acts of 6.3 (agentsow.com 0.30.0-draft). Each act is a JSON object with a closed member set: engagement, version, digest ('sha256:' and the lowercase hex SHA-256 of that version's signed bytes, 6), the kind's own members, by (the seat that signs), key (that seat's owner_key), signed_at and sig (canonical padded base64 of the 64-byte Ed25519 signature). Its signed bytes are the kind's tag, one newline, and the JCS of the act minus sig: agent-sow-terminate-v1, agent-sow-usage-v1, agent-sow-dispute-v1 and agent-sow-resolve-v1. A dispute is named by the digest of its signed bytes; a verdict by the digest of its own signed bytes (agent-arbiter-verdict-v1, one newline, JCS minus signatures). Each case names the act, its kind, the document it is made under, and for a resolve the dispute and verdict it rests on; prior lists usage acts the runtime already holds. unsettled is what remains unsettled under every engagement here when its dispute opens. pairs pin when a dispute under escalate_to_owners closes. The keys are published test seeds (sha256 of the label); 'arbiter' plays the arbiter, whose verdict signature is in the role's own encoding, base64url, as sow-disputes.json pins it. THE FIXTURE IS THE AUTHORITY: change it only with a spec change alongside.
